about: The HCP approve flow's states (step 7.27, backlog Section C part U1): one per state of hcp/approveFlow.ts's HcpApproveState that draws something (cancelled draws nothing: the caller has closed), and one per failure case. Read with agent-connect-screens.json by the screen catalogue, with the same fields. HCP words are the Hcp.<key> ids of hcp/copy.ts, read back through __tests__/fixtures/hcpWordSource.ts. Approve's rows are the VTA's effect summaries, data rather than words, so no entry lists them.
